:::{#def-measure-space}
#### Measurable space and measure space

A **measurable space** $(S, \mathscr{S})$
is a set $S$ together with a [$\sigma$-algebra](#def-sigma-algebra) $\mathscr{S}$ on $S$;
the sets in $\mathscr{S}$ are its **measurable sets**.
A **measure space** $(S, \mathscr{S}, \mu)$
is a measurable space together with a [measure](#def-measure) $\mu$ on $\mathscr{S}$.

:::
